args.body: Hi Dora! I visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. It's a nice, clean personal site that clearly introduces you and makes it easy to get in touch. A couple of suggestions to make it even stronger: consider adding a bit more about your interests, work, or projects so visitors get a fuller sense of who you are, and maybe include a few links or photos to give the page some more personality. Overall, a solid and welcoming introduction — keep it up!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. It's a great start — the site clearly feels personal and your love of hiking really comes through, which gives it a warm and distinctive voice. To make it even more engaging, you could add some actual blog posts or hiking stories, photos from your adventures, and maybe a short bio so readers know a bit more about you. I also enjoyed the restaurant link you shared in #general — the Zurich Restaurant page was a lovely read. Keep up the good work!
